scope: Synchronized latency; feature ablations can change several dependent passes. Stage windows may overlap and contain waits; their sums are not whole-frame cost or GPU utilization. Uncovered timestamp windows do not prove hardware idleness.

runs.measurement: Synchronized whole frame latency including acquisition, collection, FFT, shadows, water, temporal, presentation and GPU completion. Encoder intervals overlap and include waits; ablation differences are whole-frame effects, not isolated pass costs.
